resources.string: Turn on Show on back screen first

Shows your own images, GIFs, a clock, a charging animation and your notifications on the Xiaomi 17 Pro Max back screen, moves the app you're using there with Quick Switch, and opens Xiaomi Camera there with a swipe.

No internet permission: nothing leaves your phone.

Not affiliated with Xiaomi.

Images that don\'t fit the back screen\'s shape glide slowly across it while it\'s lit, and hold still while it\'s dimmed. With Skip short pans, an image that would barely move stays still in the middle instead; the next one pans as usual.

• Stays lit for changes Xiaomi\'s own back screen setting, so it counts with the wallpaper off too. After that time the back screen fades for about 6 seconds, then dims. Before you uninstall Mi Back Screen, choose As set to put Xiaomi\'s own time back.\n• Stay fully lit while unlocked keeps the back screen bright while you use the phone, and lets it dim once you lock it. Panning and GIFs keep going all that time, so it uses more battery.\n• Light up when you pick it up: lying on its back, the back screen switches off, and normally comes back dimmed when you pick the phone up. Once it has been dim for 90 seconds, or 5 minutes in the dark, Xiaomi switches it off for good and it stays black. This lights it again as you pick the phone up, while it\'s unlocked.
A single tap doesn\'t light a dimmed back screen; a double tap does.
